visualContract.layoutPolicy: The native connected six-slot specimen supplies 36px square slots,10px external group corners,1px joined borders and 8px group gaps; separator 24px makes the three-plus-three composition 256px wide. Value text is a single real input-otp input, with decorative groups aria-hidden and redundant separator hidden. The source library owns its input overlay, selection/paste/caret logic; CSS keeps transparent native input above the visual slots without replacing it with six inputs. LTR code order is an explicit reference choice inside RTL hosts. Digit-only pattern, maxLength 6, pasteTransformer stripping spaces/hyphens, one-time-code completion and help/error wording are caller choices. Target sets documented pushPasswordManagerStrategy=none to avoid width expansion for this fixed six-slot recipe; no claim about external password manager support. The source optional caret uses a static visible line in this no-motion reference, rather than inventing focus state or animation from Figma. Disabled opacity and real native disabled/cursor behavior remain source-specific. Readable error text accompanies invalid slot borders; native label/help/error relationships remain on the one input.
